# Test that the BOLERO_WORK environment variable flag is used by bolero work init.

! exists go.work
bolero work init
exists go.work

env BOLERO_WORK=$BOLERO_PATH/src/foo/foo.work
! exists foo/foo.work
bolero work init
exists foo/foo.work

env BOLERO_WORK=
cd foo/bar
! bolero work init
stderr 'already exists'

# Create directories to make go.work files in.
-- foo/dummy.txt --
-- foo/bar/dummy.txt --
